title: Australian Rhubarb Tart
description: A sweet and tangy tart featuring fresh rhubarb and a crumbly pastry crust.

ingredients.name: 1 cup fresh rhubarb, cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the pastry to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Trim the edges of the pastry and press it into the corners of the tart pan.
In a large bowl, combine the granulated sugar, flour, and cinnamon (if using).
Add the fresh rhubarb and toss to coat with the sugar mixture.
Arrange the rhubarb mixture in a concentric circle pattern, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Brush the melted butter over the edges of the pastry, then brush the beaten egg over the rhubarb.
Bake the tart for 40-50 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the rhubarb is tender.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack for at least 30 minutes.
Serve warm or at room temperature, garnished with fresh rhubarb or whipped cream if desired.
